newsitem.title: UK: ZENECA SEES '98 AMISTAR SALES 150 MLN STG.
newsitem.headline: ZENECA SEES '98 AMISTAR SALES 150 MLN STG.

text.p: Sales of Zeneca Group Plc's new fungicide Amistar are expected to be at least 150 million stg next year, the company said on Thursday.
In a telephone interview with Reuters, chief executive Sir David Barnes said the product had "got off brilliantly", with first-half sales of 45 million stg.

Barnes said the product was unlikely to see the same kind of growth in the second half of the year because of seasonal factors, but added "I can see Amistar being at least a 150 million pound product next year."
